summary: The migration adds a NOT NULL column whose default is gen_random_uuid. A volatile default forces PostgreSQL to rewrite the table, which holds ACCESS EXCLUSIVE for the duration.

facts.statement: The migration adds reconciliation_token NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid().
gen_random_uuid is volatile, so the default cannot be stored as metadata.

assumptions.statement: Adding a column with a default is a metadata-only operation on this table.

invariants.description: No migration statement exceeds the declared lock budget.
invariants.executable_check: Compare pg_relation_filenode across the statement; a changed filenode is a full table rewrite.
